landing.heading: Sinadaran glaze kyauta don maginan tukwane.
landing.lead: Ku fahimci glaze ɗinku, ba kawai ku haɗa shi ba. Shigar da girke-girke ku ga UMF (unity molecular formula) ɗinsa, rabon silica da alumina da daidaiton flux nan take. Ajiye girke-girkenku, kayan aiki, masu launi, rubuce-rubuce da bayanan gasa wuri ɗaya a cikin littafi na sirri.
landing.trialEnded: Gwajinku ya ƙare. Fara sabo, ko ku buɗe asusu kyauta don ajiye aikinku.
landing.trialFailed: Ba a iya fara gwaji a yanzu ba. Don Allah a sake gwadawa.
landing.heroNote: Ba sai kun yi rajista don gwadawa ba · Kyauta kuma buɗaɗɗen tushe · Girke-girkenku na sirri ne
landing.heroAlt: Jerin cone da aka gasa: farin cone a kowace ƙungiya sun lanƙwasa a cikin zafin kiln.
landing.heroCaption: Ƙungiyoyin cone bayan gasa: kowane cone yana lanƙwasa da zarar kiln ya yi isasshen aikin zafi.
landing.exampleHeading: Ga yadda yake aiki: tushen celadon na gargajiya
landing.exampleCaption: "4321" na Bernard Leach, wanda ake yawan gasawa zuwa cone 10, a sassa ta nauyi.
landing.exampleNote: Flux ɗin suna haɗuwa su zama 1, don haka ana iya kwatanta kowane glaze biyu cikin adalci. An lissafa nan a cikin burauzarku da lambar da lissafin ke amfani da ita.

unity.title: UMF nan take
unity.text: Ga flux, alumina da silica a cikin UMF, yadda masana sinadaran glaze ke kwatanta girke-girke, da zarar kun shigar da girke-girke.

substitute.title: Gyara da maye gurbi
substitute.text: An daina yin wani kaya? Kwatanta dabarunsu don samun wanda zai maye gurbinsa ya narke iri ɗaya.

notebook.title: Littafin aikinku
notebook.text: Ajiye girke-girke, kayanku, masu launi, rubuce-rubuce da bayanan gasa wuri ɗaya.

learn.title: Koyi yayin da kuke aiki
learn.text: Jagorori cikin sauƙaƙan harshe, daga mene ne glaze zuwa gasa shi cikin aminci, suna kusa da lambobin.

landing.umfRecipe: Girke-girken glaze yana faɗin yawan kowane kaya da za a auna. UMF, wanda ake kuma kira dabarar Seger, yana faɗin abin da kayan suke zama a cikin kiln: yawan molecule na kowane oxide, an daidaita su ta yadda flux ɗin za su haɗu su zama ɗaya.
landing.umfGroups: Flux yana sa glaze ya narke, alumina yana ƙara ƙarfin narkakken, silica kuma yana yin gilashin. Kwatanta waɗannan ƙungiyoyi uku yana bayyana dalilin da ya sa wani glaze yake da sheƙi wani kuma marar sheƙi, ko dalilin da ya sa wani yake gudu wani kuma yake tsayawa, kuma yana nuna yadda za a maye gurbin kayan da ba a sayarwa yanzu.
landing.closingHeading: A shirye muke idan kun shirya.
landing.closingText: Gwada lissafin yanzu, sannan ku buɗe asusu don ajiye abin da kuka yi.

about.title: Game da Glazecalc
about.lead: Lissafi da littafin sinadaran glaze, kyauta kuma buɗaɗɗen tushe, don maginan tukwane, masu yumɓu da ɗalibai.
about.what: Glazecalc yana mayar da girke-girken glaze, wato kayan da yawan kowanne da kuke aunawa, zuwa UMF ɗinsa: oxide ɗin da glaze ke ƙunshe da su bayan gasa, an daidaita su ta yadda flux ɗin za su haɗu su zama ɗaya. Hakan yana sa a iya kwatanta girke-girke, yana taimakawa wajen bayyana yadda glaze yake, kuma yana taimakawa idan dole a maye gurbin wani kaya.
about.alongside: Tare da lissafin, yana ajiye girke-girkenku, kayanku, masu launi da sauran kayan ƙari, rubuce-rubuce da bayanan gasa, shafin <advice>shawarwari kan glaze</advice> masu amfani, da <guides>jagorori</guides> don sababbin maginan tukwane, daga mene ne glaze zuwa gasa shi cikin aminci.
about.numbers: Ana bayyana kowane kaya da dabarar sinadaransa ko da sinadaran oxide ɗinsa, tare da LOI (raguwar nauyi a wuta): ɓangaren da ke ƙonewa a cikin kiln, kamar carbon dioxide da ke cikin whiting ko ruwan da ke cikin kaolin. Glazecalc yana mayar da kowane yawa zuwa mole na kowane oxide da nauyin molar na yau da kullum, yana haɗa su a duk girke-girken, sannan yana raba su da jimillar mole na flux. Ana jera masu launi da sauran kayan ƙari tare da girke-girke amma ba a saka su a cikin UMF ba, kamar yadda aka saba.
about.guide: Sakamakon jagora ne, ba tabbaci ba. Ainihin kaya suna bambanta daga mai sayarwa zuwa mai sayarwa da daga batch zuwa batch, kuma gasa yana da muhimmanci kamar sinadarai, don haka ku gwada kowane glaze. Ya kamata a gwada glaze na wuraren da abinci ke taɓawa don zubar ƙarfe (leaching).
about.built: An fara Glazecalc a 2017 kuma an sake gina shi a 2026. Ƙaramar manhajar yanar gizo ce guda ɗaya, kuma <source>lambar tushensa tana kan GitHub</source> ƙarƙashin MIT License.
about.stackBrowser: Angular 22 a cikin burauza (standalone components da signals), tare da sinadaran glaze a cikin ƙaramin ɗakin karatu da ake rabawa.
about.stackServer: API na TypeScript a kan Node.js 24 da Express 5, tare da MongoDB 9, wanda gwaje-gwaje na atomatik fiye da 350 ke dubawa.
about.stackHosting: Yana gudana a Docker a kan Amazon Web Services, bayan nginx tare da HTTPS daga Let's Encrypt.
about.stackDeploy: GitHub Actions ne ke tura shi: ana gina hotuna kuma a gwada su a kowane canji, kuma turawa tana shiga AWS ba tare da ajiyayyun maɓallai ba.
about.credits: Yankunan da ke kan jadawalin Stull sun fito ne daga karatun Glazy na jadawalin R. T. Stull na 1912, na Derek Au (Copyright (c) 2017 Derek Au, MIT License). <notices>Cikakkiyar sanarwar</notices> tana cikin lambar tushe.
about.who: Aaron Filson ne ya yi Glazecalc. Kun sami matsala ko kuna da ra'ayi? <issues>Buɗe issue a GitHub</issues>.
about.studio: Tukwanen hannu na Aaron Filson suna a <studio>Updraft Pottery Studio</studio> a Tacoma, Washington. Ku duba aikin, kuma ku yi odar guda idan wani ya burge ku.
about.languages: Ana samun Glazecalc a waɗannan harsuna. Kowane mahaɗi yana buɗe wannan shafi a wannan harshe.

privacy.title: Sirri
privacy.short: Glazecalc yana ajiye abin da yake buƙata don gudanar da asusunku kawai, ba fiye ba. Babu talla, babu bincike, babu bin diddigi. Ba a taɓa sayar da bayananku ba, kuma kamfani ɗaya tilo da ke sarrafa su shi ne Amazon Web Services, wanda ke ɗaukar shafin kuma yake aika imel ɗinsa.
privacy.who: Glazecalc aiki ne na kyauta, buɗaɗɗen tushe, ba don riba ba, wanda mai shi, Aaron Filson, ke gudanarwa a Amurka. Shi ne ke yanke shawarar abin da ke faruwa da bayananku, don haka a dokar kare bayanai shi ne "controller" ɗinsu.
privacy.contact: Don tambaya game da bayananku, ko don amfani da kowane haƙƙinku, ku rubuta zuwa <mail>privacy@glazecalcapp.com</mail>. Kuna kuma iya <issues>buɗe issue a GitHub</issues>, amma issue na fili ne: kada ku taɓa saka adireshin imel ɗinku ko wani abu na kanku a ciki. Yawancin abubuwa game da bayananku kuna iya yin su da kanku a <account>shafin asusunku</account>.
privacy.storedHeading: Abin da ake ajiyewa, da dalili
privacy.storedAccount: Asusunku: adireshin imel ɗinku, da kalmar sirrinku, wadda ake ajiyewa a matsayin hash mai hanya ɗaya kawai (bcrypt), ba a taɓa ajiye kalmar sirrin kanta ba. Ana ajiye saitunanku (kamar harshe, yanki da ma'auni) da jerin kayan da kuke da su tare da shi. Asusu yana buƙatar adireshin imel, don shiga da kuma sake saita kalmar sirri da aka manta. Idan kun buɗe asusu, ana aika mahaɗi zuwa adireshin don tabbatar da cewa naku ne; har zuwa lokacin, ana aika saƙo zuwa gare shi ne kawai idan kun nema, kamar sake saita kalmar sirri.
privacy.storedShelf: Jerin kafin canjinku na ƙarshe ga kayan da kuke da su: duk lokacin da jerin ya canza, a shafin yanar gizo, da access token ko ta manhajar da aka haɗa, ana ajiye jerin kamar yadda yake kafin canjin tare da asusunku, don a iya soke canjin sau ɗaya. Canji na gaba yana maye gurbinsa, kuma soke canjin yana cire shi. Yana cikin Sauke bayanaina, kuma yana tafiya idan kun share asusunku.
privacy.storedPrices: Farashi, idan kun bayar: abin da kuke biya kan kowane kaya, a kowace kilogram, da kuɗin da suke a ciki, don kuɗin batch. Bayanan kasuwanci ne, ana ajiye su tare da asusunku kuma na sirri ne gare shi: ba sa cikin girke-girke, don haka babu abin da kuka raba da ke nuna su. Sauke bayanaina yana ƙunshe da su, kuma share asusun yana share su. Farashin gwaji suna shiga asusunku tare da bayanansa, don kayan da ba ku sa wa farashi ba, idan duka suna cikin kuɗi ɗaya.
privacy.storedEmailChange: Canza imel ɗinku: ranar da adireshinku ya canza na ƙarshe, ta yadda ba za a taɓa karɓar buƙatar kashe shiga mataki biyu daga sabon adireshi a cikin kwana 30 bayan haka ba.
privacy.storedSignIn: Shiga mataki biyu, idan kun kunna shi: ko yana kunne; maɓallin da manhajar authenticator ɗinku ke rabawa da Glazecalc, a ɓoye; kan kowane passkey, maɓallinsa na fili (wanda ba zai iya shiga shi kaɗai ba) tare da id da bayanan da na'urarku ke ba shi, sunan da kuka ba shi, da lokacin da aka ƙara shi da lokacin da aka yi amfani da shi na ƙarshe; lambobin dawo da shigarku, a matsayin hash mai hanya ɗaya mai maɓalli kawai, don kada kowa ya iya karanta su; kuma, idan wani ya shigar da kalmar sirrinku amma bai gama mataki na biyu ba, lokacin da Glazecalc ya aika muku imel game da hakan na ƙarshe (bai wuce sau ɗaya a rana ba). Yayin da kuke shiga, tsakanin kalmar sirrinku da mataki na biyu, sabar tana ajiye bayanin shigar na minti 5, kuma shafin yana riƙe da ɗan gajeren token a ƙwaƙwalwarsa kawai: babu sabon cookie, babu komai a ma'ajiyar burauzarku.
privacy.storedSaved: Abin da kuke ajiyewa: girke-girkenku, kayan aiki, kayan ƙari, rubuce-rubuce, bayanan gasa da shawarwari, kamar yadda kuka rubuta su. Ku kaɗai ne za ku iya ganin su, sai dai idan kun raba girke-girke ta mahaɗi.
privacy.storedTrash: Kwandon shara da sigogin da suka gabata: abin da kuka cire daga jeri yana jira a Kwandon shara, cikakke, don ku iya dawo da shi; kuma kowane canjin da kuka ajiye ga bayani yana ajiye bayanin kamar yadda yake kafin haka, don ku iya soke canjin.
privacy.storedShares: Girke-girken da kuka raba ta mahaɗi, idan kun raba: wane girke-girke, lokacin da aka yi mahaɗinsa da ko yana nuna rubuce-rubucen girke-girken, tare da hash mai hanya ɗaya na mahaɗin (ba a taɓa ajiye mahaɗin kansa ba). Duk wanda ke da mahaɗin zai iya ganin girke-girken kamar yadda yake yanzu, tare da UMF ɗinsa, da rubuce-rubucensa idan kun zaɓi a nuna su; ba a taɓa nuna imel ɗinku, asusunku ko wani farashi ba. Ana hana injunan bincike ganin girke-girken da aka raba, kuma mahaɗin ba ya taɓa isa ga bayanan log na sabar. Don hana zalunci, ana ƙidaya girke-girken da aka raba da aka buɗe daga kowane adireshin IP, a ƙwaƙwalwa, na minti 15. Gwaji ba zai iya rabawa ba.
privacy.storedTokens: Access token da manhajojin da aka haɗa, idan kun yi ko kun amince da wani: kan kowanne, sunansa, abin da zai iya yi, da lokacin da aka yi shi, aka yi amfani da shi na ƙarshe, zai ƙare da aka soke shi; kan access token, har da hash mai hanya ɗaya na token ɗin (ba a taɓa ajiye token ɗin kansa ba) da haruffansa 4 na ƙarshe. Abin da ake ajiyewa don manhajar da aka haɗa yana ƙarƙashin "Haɗa manhajar AI", a ƙasa.
privacy.storedActivity: Abin da token da manhajoji suka yi: layi ɗaya kan kowane bayani da access token ko manhajar da aka haɗa ta ƙirƙira, ta canza, ta mayar zuwa Kwandon shara, ta dawo da shi ko ta soke: yaushe, wane token ko manhaja, abin da ta yi da taken bayanin, a gajarce. Ba a taɓa ajiye rubutun rubutu ko wani abu dabam a cikin bayanin ba. Ba a jera canje-canjen da kuke yi a shafin yanar gizo ba. Kuna ganin waɗannan layuka a shafin Manhajojin da aka haɗa, da cikin Sauke bayanaina.
privacy.storedPending: Canje-canjen da ke jiran amincewarku, idan kun nemi a tabbatar da canje-canje: idan access token ko manhajar da aka haɗa ta nemi canza bayananku kuma kun zaɓi ku amince da irin waɗannan canje-canje da farko, canjin yana jira: abin da zai yi (wanda zai iya haɗa da rubutun rubutu ko girke-girke), wane token ko manhaja ta nema, da yaushe. Ku kaɗai ne za ku iya amincewa da shi, bayan kun shiga. Ana cire bayanansa da zarar kun amince ko kun ƙi shi.
privacy.storedLimits: Iyakoki kan yawan sau: don hana zato da rubutun kwamfuta da suka fita daga iko, ƙidayar ƙoƙarin shiga, rajista, buƙatun sake saita da gwaje-gwaje ta adireshin IP ko asusu, na access token da ba sa aiki ta adireshin IP, na buƙatun da aka yi da access token, ta asusu (120 a minti da 5,000 a rana), na canje-canjen da aka yi da access token, ta asusu (60 a minti da 5,000 a rana), na bayanan da kowane access token ke mayarwa zuwa Kwandon shara, ta token, na girke-girken da aka raba da aka buɗe da na mahaɗan rabawa da ba sa buɗe komai, ta adireshin IP, da na buƙatu zuwa kayan aikin mataimakan AI (MCP): 60 a minti da 2,000 a rana ta adireshin IP, ko 300 a minti da 20,000 a rana ta asusu idan an yi amfani da access token, tare da maye gurbi ko daidaitawa da bai wuce 10 a minti ba.
privacy.storedTrial: Gwaji ("Gwada yanzu"): babu imel ko kalmar sirri, sai suna da aka ƙirƙira kawai kamar "speckled quiet kilns". Idan kun shiga asusu a burauza ɗaya yayin gwaji, abin da kuka yi a gwajin yana shiga asusun.
privacy.storedResets: Mahaɗan sake saita kalmar sirri da na imel: wane asusu ya nema, yaushe, adireshin da aka aika mahaɗin tabbatar da adireshi zuwa gare shi, da alamar kowane mahaɗi (ba mahaɗin kansa ba).
privacy.storedLogs: Log: sabar yanar gizo tana rubuta kowace buƙata: adireshin IP ɗinku, lokaci, shafin da aka nema da sunan burauzarku. Manhajar tana rubuta kurakurai tare da shafin da suka faru a kai, ba a taɓa rubuta adireshin imel ɗinku ba.
privacy.storedDeletions: Asusun da aka share: lambar id na asusun da lokacin da aka share shi, ba komai dabam, ta yadda madadin da aka dawo da shi ba zai iya dawo da asusun ba.
privacy.storedMail: Matsalolin imel: idan saƙo zuwa adireshinku ya dawo ko aka ba da rahotonsa a matsayin spam, sabis ɗin imel na Amazon yana saka adireshin a jerin waɗanda ba za a sake aika wa saƙo ba, kuma yana aika wa mai shi sanarwa da ke ɗauke da adireshin.
privacy.storedInbound: Saƙon da kuke aika wa Glazecalc: saƙo zuwa privacy@glazecalcapp.com da sauran adireshin Glazecalc Amazon na duba su don spam da ƙwayoyin cuta na kwamfuta, ana ajiye su a ma'ajiya ta sirri, kuma ana tura su zuwa akwatin saƙon mai shi (Gmail).
privacy.basisContract: Gudanar da asusunku, ajiye abin da kuke ajiyewa, da imel game da asusunku su ne sabis ɗin da kuka nema: tushen doka shi ne yarjejeniya tsakaninku da Glazecalc (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)).
privacy.basisInterests: Kiyaye shafin lafiya da aiki: log, iyakoki kan yawan sau da kowa zai iya ƙoƙarin shiga, madadin, bayanin asusun da aka share da jerin adireshin da ba za a aika wa saƙo ba. Waɗannan sun dogara ne kan halattacciyar bukatar Glazecalc ta tsaro, hana zalunci da rashin rasa aikinku (Article 6(1)(f)). Ana ajiye su na ɗan lokaci kuma ba a amfani da su don komai dabam. Kuna iya ƙin su ta rubuta zuwa adireshin da ke sama.
privacy.basisNone: Babu wani abu game da ku da ake yanke shawara a kansa ta atomatik, babu tantance halaye, kuma babu abin da ake amfani da shi don talla.
privacy.whereHeading: Inda ake ajiye shi, da wanda ke sarrafa shi
privacy.hosting: Glazecalc yana gudana a kan Amazon Web Services (AWS): sabar (EC2), madadin (S3) da imel (Simple Email Service), duka a Amurka, a Oregon (us-west-2). AWS na sarrafa bayanan ne kawai a madadin Glazecalc, ƙarƙashin <dpa>sharuɗɗan sarrafa bayanai</dpa> nasa. Babu wani dabam da ke karɓar su.
privacy.transfer: Idan kuna zaune a EU, UK ko Switzerland, bayananku suna zuwa Amurka. Amazon ya ce yana da takardar shaida ƙarƙashin <dpf>EU–US Data Privacy Framework</dpf> da ƙarin sa na UK da Switzerland, kuma sharuɗɗan AWS sun ƙunshi Standard Contractual Clauses na EU, waɗanda za su ci gaba da aiki idan aka soke Framework ɗin, wanda yanzu ake ƙalubalanta a kotu. Mai shi da AWS duka suna Amurka, kuma dokar Amurka na iya tilasta musu su ba da bayanai.
privacy.noThirdParties: Burauzarku ba ta lodawa komai daga wasu shafukan yanar gizo: babu font, rubutun kwamfuta, hotuna ko bincike daga wani wuri, kuma saitunan tsaron shafin suna hana su. Ana bin mahaɗan GitHub da sauran shafuka ne kawai idan kun danna su.
privacy.appsIntro: Kuna iya bar manhajar AI, kamar Claude ko ChatGPT, ta yi amfani da bayananku na Glazecalc. Manhajar tana neman haɗawa, kuma ku shiga ku ce eh a shafin Glazecalc na kansa. Daga nan za ta iya karanta bayananku; za ta iya canza su ne kawai idan kun kuma yarda da hakan. Babu abin da ake haɗawa sai kun zaɓa. Duk lokacin da kuka haɗa manhaja, Glazecalc yana aika muku imel na sanarwa da ke faɗin sunanta, abin da za ta iya yi, da mahaɗi zuwa inda za ku iya soke ta.
privacy.appsStored: Abin da ake ajiyewa kan kowace manhajar da aka haɗa: sunan da manhajar ke ba kanta; kan manhajar da ke bayyana kanta ta adireshin yanar gizo, wannan adireshi, wanda Glazecalc ke karanta bayananta daga gare shi; kan manhajar da ke yi wa kanta rajista, abin da ta faɗa game da kanta kawai, wanda Glazecalc ba zai iya dubawa ba; sunan host na adireshin da ake mayar da burauzarku zuwa gare shi bayan kun ce eh; abin da za ta iya yi (karantawa, ko karantawa da canzawa); lokacin da kuka haɗa ta, lokacin da aka yi amfani da ita na ƙarshe da lokacin da za ta ƙare; da ko an soke ta, da dalili. Ana ajiye lambobinta da token ɗinta a matsayin hash mai hanya ɗaya kawai, ba a taɓa ajiye lambobin ko token ɗin kansu ba. Abin da ta ƙirƙira, ta canza, ta mayar zuwa Kwandon shara, ta dawo da shi ko ta soke ana rubuta shi a jerin abin da token da manhajoji suka yi, a sama, kuma kowane bayanin da ta mayar zuwa Kwandon shara ana yi masa alama da haɗin da ya mayar da shi. Yayin da kuke cewa eh, sabar tana ajiye bayanin buƙatar manhajar kuma, da zarar kun amsa, na asusunku. Don hana zalunci, ana ƙidaya buƙatun haɗa manhajoji ta adireshin IP, a ƙwaƙwalwar sabar, kamar sauran iyakoki.
privacy.appsFetched: Abin da Glazecalc ke samo: idan manhajar da ke bayyana kanta ta adireshin yanar gizo ta nemi haɗawa, kuma lokaci zuwa lokaci yayin da take haɗe, sabar Glazecalc tana karanta bayanan manhajar (ƙaramin fayil mai sunanta da adireshinta) daga wannan adireshi, a shafin manhajar na kanta. Wannan buƙata tana tafiya daga sabar Glazecalc zuwa host ɗin manhajar, kuma ba ta ɗauke da komai game da ku. Ana ajiye fayil ɗin a ƙwaƙwalwar sabar na awa 1 zuwa 24. Da zarar wani ya haɗa manhajar, ana kuma ajiye kwafin fayil ɗin a ma'ajiyar bayanan Glazecalc, don manhajar ta ci gaba da aiki idan ba a iya karanta fayil ɗin na ɗan lokaci ba; ana sake karanta shi kowace awa 1 zuwa 24. Kwafin yana ɗauke da bayanan manhajar kawai, ba komai game da ku, kuma ana share shi bayan haɗi na ƙarshe zuwa manhajar ya ƙare, a ƙarshe lokacin da wannan haɗi zai ƙare. Babu wani abu dabam da ake samo daga manhaja, kuma babu abin da ke lodawa daga gare ta a shafukan Glazecalc.
privacy.appsKept: Har yaushe: haɗin da zai iya karantawa kawai yana ƙarewa kwana 60 bayan manhajar ta sabunta damarta na ƙarshe, wanda take yi yayin da kuke amfani da ita; wanda zai iya kuma canza bayananku yana ƙarewa kwana 90 bayan kun yarda da shi, kuma ba a taɓa sabunta shi ba. Kamar access token, ana ajiye bayaninsa na kwana 30 bayan haɗin ya ƙare ko zai ƙare, don ku ga lokacin da ya tsaya. Ana ajiye lamba na minti ɗaya, access token na awa ɗaya, da refresh token muddin haɗin yana nan. Soke haɗi yana share su nan take; idan ya ƙare, sun daina aiki kuma sun tafi cikin awa ɗaya. Manhajar da ta yi wa kanta rajista ana manta da ita kwana 7 bayan ta yi rajista idan babu wanda ya haɗa ta, ko kwana 30 bayan an yi amfani da ita na ƙarshe. Bayanin da aka yi yayin da kuke cewa eh yana tafiya bayan minti 15. Ana ajiye abin da manhajar ta yi na kwana 90. Share asusunku yana share duka.
privacy.appsEnd: Kawo ƙarshensa: Manhajojin da aka haɗa, a shafin asusunku, yana jera kowace manhaja tare da abin da ta yi, yana dawo da abin da ta mayar zuwa Kwandon shara, kuma yana soke manhaja ɗaya ko duka; manhajar da kuka soke tana tsayawa nan take. Sake saita kalmar sirri ko "Fita a ko'ina" yana kawo ƙarshen kowane haɗi, kamar yadda yake yi wa kowane access token; canza kalmar sirrinku ba ya yi. Sake haɗa manhaja ɗaya yana kawo ƙarshen haɗinta na baya, kuma manhaja za ta iya kawo ƙarshen nata.
privacy.appsTheirs: Abin da manhajar ke yi da bayananku ya rage ga manhajar da wanda ya yi ta. Manhajar ta wani kamfani ne dabam, mai alhaki ƙarƙashin manufofin sirrinsa kan abin da kuka faɗa masa da abin da Glazecalc ya aika masa bisa buƙatarku; Glazecalc ba shi da iko a kai.
privacy.choiceHeading: Inda ake ajiye asusunku, da zaɓinku
privacy.choiceProject: Glazecalc aiki ne na kyauta, buɗaɗɗen tushe. Ana ajiye asusu, da duk abin da ke cikinsu, a sabobi a Amurka, a duk inda kuke zaune, kamar yadda aka bayyana a sama.
privacy.choiceNoAccount: Ba sai kuna da asusu ba don karanta jagororin, kuma kuna iya gwada lissafin da "Gwada yanzu", ba tare da adireshin imel ko kalmar sirri ba. Ana ajiye gwaji a sabobi ɗaya na kwana 14.
privacy.choiceOwnCopy: Kowa na iya gudanar da nasa kwafin Glazecalc, a kwamfutarsa ko sabarsa: lambar kyauta ce a <source>GitHub</source>.
privacy.choiceDecision: Ko za ku buɗe asusu a nan, da sanin cewa ana ajiye shi a Amurka, shawararku ce.
privacy.choiceNoWarranty: Ana bayar da Glazecalc yadda yake, ba tare da garanti ba. Masu kula da shi ba sa ɗaukar wani alhaki ko nauyi kan shawararku ta buɗe asusu, ko kan inda ake ajiye bayanansa.
privacy.keptAccount: Asusunku da abin da kuke ajiyewa: har sai kun share su. Ba a cire asusu saboda rashin amfani.
privacy.keptTrash: Kwandon shara da sigogin da suka gabata: bayanin da aka cire kwana 30 bayan kun cire shi, ko har sai kun share shi har abada ko kun zubar da Kwandon shara; sigogin da suka gabata kwana 90, kuma na ƙarshe 20 kawai na kowane bayani (da na kafin canje-canjen access token) da na ƙarshe 20,000 na duk asusun, amma ba fiye da bayanin ba: yayin da yake cikin Kwandon shara sigoginsa suna tafiya idan ya tafi. Duka suna tafiya nan take idan kun share asusunku.
privacy.keptShares: Mahaɗan rabawa: har sai kun daina raba girke-girken, kun yi sabon mahaɗi gare shi, kun mayar da shi zuwa Kwandon shara ko kun share asusunku. Dawo da girke-girken daga Kwandon shara ba ya sake raba shi. Sake saita kalmar sirrinku ko fita a ko'ina shi ma yana dakatar da dukkan mahaɗanku; canza kalmar sirrinku ba ya yi.
privacy.keptTokens: Access token da manhajojin da aka haɗa: ana ajiye kowanne har sai ya ƙare sannan ƙarin kwana 30 (kowane access token na kai yana ƙarewa cikin shekara ɗaya bai wuce haka ba; tsawon lokacin manhajar da aka haɗa yana ƙarƙashin "Haɗa manhajar AI"), ko har sai kun share asusunku. Sake saita kalmar sirri ko "Fita a ko'ina" yana dakatar da su duka nan take.
privacy.keptActivity: Abin da token da manhajoji suka yi: kwana 90, ko har sai kun share asusunku.
privacy.keptPending: Canje-canjen da ke jiran amincewarku: minti 30 bai wuce haka ba, sannan ba a canza komai kuma ana cire su; ana cire abin da canji zai yi da zarar kun amince ko kun ƙi shi.
privacy.keptLimits: Iyakoki kan yawan sau: ana ajiye ƙidayar a ƙwaƙwalwar sabar kawai, na minti 1 zuwa awa 24, kuma suna ɓacewa idan ta sake farawa.
privacy.keptTrial: Gwaji: kwana 14 daga farkonsa, sannan ana share shi tare da duk abin da ke ciki, sai dai idan kun buɗe asusu don ajiye shi.
privacy.keptResets: Mahaɗan sake saita kalmar sirri da na imel: mahaɗin sake saita yana aiki na minti 30 kuma ana share bayaninsa bayan kusan awa ɗaya; mahaɗin tabbatar da adireshi yana aiki, kuma ana ajiye shi, na awa 24.
privacy.keptSignIn: Shiga mataki biyu: kowace manhajar authenticator, passkey da saitin lambobin dawo da shiga har sai kun cire shi, kun kashe shiga mataki biyu ko kun share asusunku. Shigar da ke jiran mataki na biyu ana share ta bayan minti 5, kuma manhaja ko passkey da kuka fara ƙarawa amma ba ku gama ba, bayan bai wuce 10 ba.
privacy.keptBackups: Madadi: ana ajiye kwafin ma'ajiyar bayanai a ɓoye na kwana 30, da kwafin faifan sabar na kwana 7. Don haka asusun da aka share ya tafi daga kowane madadi cikin kwana 30.
privacy.keptDeletions: Bayanin asusun da aka share: kwana 37, ɗan fi kowane madadi tsawo.
privacy.keptLogs: Log: na sabar yanar gizo, kwana 14. Log na manhajar da na ma'ajiyar bayanai girmansu ne ke iyakance su (50 MB kowanne), wanda a shafi mai shiru yana komawa baya kwanaki da dama. Kwafin faifan sabar yana ajiye log har zuwa ƙarin kwana 7.
privacy.keptMail: Jerin adireshin da ba za a aika wa saƙo ba: har sai mai shi ya cire adireshi, wanda yake yi kowane wata don adireshin da ba na wani asusu ba ne yanzu. Mai shi yana share sanarwar dawowar saƙo cikin kwana 30.
privacy.keptInbound: Saƙon da kuke aika wa Glazecalc: kwana 30 a ma'ajiyar Amazon, kuma a akwatin saƙon mai shi muddin ana buƙatar lokaci don amsa muku. Kan buƙata game da bayananku, ana ajiye ɗan gajeren bayani (lokacin da ta zo, abin da aka tambaya da abin da aka yi) na shekara uku.
privacy.rightsIntro: Kuna iya gani, gyara, ɗauka da share bayananku. Yawancinsa kuna iya yi da kanku a <account>shafin asusunku</account>:
privacy.rightsExport: Ku gan shi ku ɗauke shi: Sauke bayanaina yana ajiye komai a fayil ɗaya (JSON), har da sunaye da kwanakin hanyoyin shiga mataki biyunku (ba a taɓa haɗa maɓallansu ko lambobinsu ba), da girke-girkenku da kayanku a matsayin spreadsheet (CSV).
privacy.rightsCorrect: Gyara shi: canza saitunanku da bayananku a kowane lokaci. Don canza adireshin imel ɗinku, buɗe mahaɗin da aka aika zuwa sabon adireshin; ana sanar da tsohon adireshin, idan an tabbatar da shi, game da canjin, kuma ana fitar da kowace na'ura.
privacy.rightsDelete: Share shi: Share asusuna yana cire asusunku da duk abin da kuka ajiye nan take, kuma "Watsar da gwaji" yana yin haka ga gwaji. Kwafi a madadi suna tafiya cikin kwana 30.
privacy.rightsSignOut: Fita a ko'ina: yana kawo ƙarshen zaman asusunku a kowace na'ura.
privacy.rightsAsk: Kan kowane abu dabam, kamar neman a dakatar da amfani da bayananku yayin da ake gyara kuskure, ko ƙin yadda ake amfani da su, ku rubuta zuwa <mail>privacy@glazecalcapp.com</mail>. Kyauta ne, kuma za ku sami amsa cikin wata ɗaya. Za a nemi ku nuna cewa asusun naku ne kawai, ta shiga ko ta buɗe mahaɗin da aka aika zuwa adireshinsa, ba a taɓa neman katin shaida ba.
privacy.rightsComplain: Idan ba ku gamsu ba, kuna iya kai ƙara zuwa hukumar kare bayanai: a EU, <edpb>hukumar ƙasarku</edpb>, a UK kuma, <ico>Information Commissioner's Office</ico>.
privacy.storageIntro: Glazecalc yana saita cookie biyu, na biyun kawai yayin da kuke shiga da Google, GitHub ko Microsoft. A burauzarku kuma yana ajiye ƙananan ƙima kaɗan, rubutun manhajar don amfani ba tare da intanet ba, kuma, sai idan kun kunna shi, kwafin bayananku da canje-canjen da kuka yi ba tare da intanet ba. Kowanne yana nan ne don wani abu da kuka nema: kasancewa a ciki, shiga da Google, GitHub ko Microsoft, tuna zaɓin da kuka yi, ko amfani da manhajar ba tare da intanet ba. Babu ɗaya da ke bin diddiginku kuma babu wanda ake rabawa, don haka doka ba ta buƙatar a fara tambaya, kuma babu tutar cookie.
privacy.storageNote: Kuna iya share kowane ɗayan waɗannan a saitunan burauzarku a kowane lokaci. Share asusunku yana cire bayanin shiga, kowane saitin da aka ajiye a nan da kwafin bayananku.

offlineRecords.purpose: Sai idan kun kunna "Ajiye bayanaina a wannan na'ura" a shafin asusunku: kwafin girke-girkenku, kayayyaki, ƙari, gasawa, bayanan kula, saituna da farashi, da canje-canjen da kuke yi ba tare da intanet ba har sai an aika su, don su buɗe kuma a iya gyara su ba tare da intanet ba. offlineRecords yana lura cewa kun kunna shi. Kwafin yana zama a wannan burauza a wannan na'ura kuma ba a taɓa aika shi ko'ina ba. Glazecalc ba ya ɓoye shi (encrypt); burauzarku kaɗai ce ke kare shi, wadda ke raba ajiyar kowane shafi, da kuma ɓoyewar na'urarku ta kanta, idan tana da ita.
offlineRecords.lasts: Har sai kun share shi ko burauzarku ta cire shi. Yana zama a wannan na'ura idan kun rufe burauzar, kun sake kunna na'urar, kun fita (idan kun zaɓi Ajiye a wannan na'ura) ko shigarku ta ƙare. Kuna share shi ta hanyar zaɓar Share daga wannan na'ura lokacin da kuke fita, ta hanyar kashe "Ajiye bayanaina a wannan na'ura", ko da "Share bayanan da aka ajiye don amfani ba tare da intanet ba" a shafin asusunku. Idan wani ya shiga a wannan burauza, ba zai iya ganinsa ba. Burauzarku na iya cire shi da kanta, misali Safari bayan kwana 7 ba tare da amfani ba. Share asusunku a nan yana share shi ma. Ba a cire kwafi a wata na'ura idan kun share asusunku a wani wuri, ko kun fita a wani wuri; ku share shi a waccan na'urar.

offlineOutbox.purpose: Yana lura cewa canje-canjen da kuka yi ba tare da intanet ba suna jira a wannan na'ura don a aika su zuwa Glazecalc, don manhajar ta san ta neme su. Canje-canjen kansu ana ajiye su a cikin rumbun bayanai na IndexedDB ɗaya da kwafin bayananku, ƙarƙashin offlineRecords a sama. Ba ya ɗauke da bayanan sirri.
offlineOutbox.lasts: Har sai an aika canje-canjen ko kun share su (ku fita ku zaɓi Share daga wannan na'ura, ku kashe "Ajiye bayanaina a wannan na'ura", ko "Share bayanan da aka ajiye don amfani ba tare da intanet ba"). Canje-canjen da ba a aika ba tukuna suna zama a wannan na'ura idan kun rufe burauzar, kun sake kunna na'urar ko kun fita kuka zaɓi Ajiye a wannan na'ura.

offlineFiles.purpose: Rubutun manhajar da jagororinta a harshenku da Turanci, don shafuka su buɗe ba tare da intanet ba, da kuma wane harshe aka ajiye da kuma yaushe. Babu bayanan sirri.
offlineFiles.lasts: Har sai kun share ajiyar burauzarku. Ana sake ajiyewa sau ɗaya a rana; ana cire fayilolin wani harshe idan kun canza harshe.

cookie.purpose: Yana riƙe ku a ciki. Yana ɗauke da token ɗin shigarku. Rubutun kwamfuta a shafin ba za su iya karanta shi ba, kuma burauzarku tana aika shi ne kawai zuwa sabar Glazecalc ta kanta, ta HTTPS, kuma ba a taɓa aika shi da buƙatar da ta fara a wani shafi ba.
cookie.lasts: Ana saita shi idan kun shiga, kun buɗe asusu ko kun fara gwaji. Har sai kun rufe burauzarku, ko na kwana 7 idan kun yi alama a "Riƙe ni a ciki a wannan na'ura"; kwana 14 don gwaji. Fita yana cire shi.

session.purpose: Yana lura cewa kun shiga, cikin asusu ko gwaji, don manhajar ta san ta tambayi sabar. Ba ya ɗauke da token ko kalmar sirri.
session.lasts: Har sai kun fita ko zaman ya ƙare.

trial.purpose: Yayin gwaji, sunansa da ranar ƙarewarsa, don a nuna su.
trial.lasts: Har sai gwajin ya ƙare, ko aka ajiye shi ko aka watsar da shi.

settings.purpose: Saitin da kuka canza a wannan burauza, don shafi na gaba ya nuna shi nan take, kafin sabar ta amsa. theme da palette suna sa wa shafin launi kafin ya bayyana, kuma language yana buɗe shafuka a harshenku.
settings.lasts: Har sai kun canza shi. Babu abin da ake cirewa da kansa: idan kun dawo bayan kusan shekara ɗaya ba ku nan, sanarwa tana ba da maɓalli don share saitunanku. Fita yana dawo da abin da kuka zaɓa yayin da kuke waje, idan akwai, kuma yana cire sauran.

visitor.purpose: Harshen da kuka zaɓa, ko cewa kun rufe sanarwar fassara, yayin da kuke waje, don ya dawo idan kun fita.
visitor.lasts: Har sai kun share ma'ajiyar burauzarku ko kun share asusu a wannan burauza. Babu abin da ake cirewa da kansa: idan kun dawo bayan kusan shekara ɗaya ba ku nan, sanarwa tana ba da maɓalli don share saitunanku.

region.lasts: Har sai kun mayar da matatar zuwa dukkan yankuna. Babu abin da ake cirewa da kansa: idan kun dawo bayan kusan shekara ɗaya ba ku nan, sanarwa tana ba da maɓalli don share saitunanku.

includeAdditives.purpose: Ko sababbin girke-girke suna ƙidaya kayan ƙarinsu a cikin UMF, kamar yadda kuka zaɓa na ƙarshe.
includeAdditives.lasts: Har sai kun share ma'ajiyar burauzarku. Babu abin da ake cirewa da kansa: idan kun dawo bayan kusan shekara ɗaya ba ku nan, sanarwa tana ba da maɓalli don share saitunanku.

print.purpose: Zaɓuɓɓukanku na ƙarshe don buga girke-girke: girke-girken gaba ɗaya, batch ko takardar aiki, da girman batch.
print.lasts: Har sai kun share ma'ajiyar burauzarku. Babu abin da ake cirewa da kansa: idan kun dawo bayan kusan shekara ɗaya ba ku nan, sanarwa tana ba da maɓalli don share saitunanku.

recipeLayout.purpose: Tsarin da kuka zaɓa na ƙarshe don fom ɗin girke-girke: na yau da kullum, teburin aiki ko mataki-mataki.
recipeLayout.lasts: Har sai kun share ma'ajiyar burauzarku. Babu abin da ake cirewa da kansa: idan kun dawo bayan kusan shekara ɗaya ba ku nan, sanarwa tana ba da maɓalli don share saitunanku.

settingsDates.purpose: Lokacin da wannan burauza ta buɗe Glazecalc na ƙarshe da saitunan da ke sama, don idan kun dawo bayan kusan shekara ɗaya ba ku nan a iya nuna sanarwar da ke ba da damar share su, da kuma wace sigar sanarwar fassara kuka rufe. Babu bayanan sirri.
settingsDates.lasts: Muddin ana ajiye ko ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan saitunan a nan.

token.purpose: Token ɗin shiga daga tsohon sigar Glazecalc. Ba a taɓa rubuta shi yanzu.
token.lasts: Ana cire shi idan shafi ya buɗe.

readEnglish.purpose: Cewa kun zaɓi karanta shafin da aka fassara a Turanci, don manhajar ta daina mayar da ku zuwa harshenku.
readEnglish.lasts: Har sai kun rufe tab ɗin.

reloadedFor.purpose: Bayan an fitar da sabon sigar shafin, wane shafi aka sake lodawa da yaushe, don shafi ya sake lodawa bai wuce sau ɗaya a minti ba.
reloadedFor.lasts: Har sai kun rufe tab ɗin.

oauthCookie.purpose: Yayin da kuke shiga da Google, GitHub ko Microsoft kawai: yana ɗaure amsar mai bayarwa da burauzarku, don kada wani ya iya gama shigarku ko ya fara muku ɗaya. Rubutun kwamfuta a shafin ba za su iya karanta shi ba.
oauthCookie.lasts: Ana saita shi idan kun danna "Ci gaba da Google", "Ci gaba da GitHub" ko "Shiga da Microsoft", ko kun haɗa ɗaya a shafin asusunku. Ana cire shi idan shigar ta gama, ko bayan minti 10.

privacy.children: Glazecalc kayan aiki ne don maginan tukwane kuma ba don yara aka yi shi ba.
privacy.changes: Idan wannan sanarwa ta canza, kwanan wata a saman shafin shi ma yana canzawa.
privacy.storedProviders: Google, GitHub ko Microsoft, idan kun shiga da ɗaya: id na mai bayarwa na kansa a gare ku (lamba ko lambar da ba ta taɓa canzawa; kan Microsoft, tare da id na directory ɗin da asusunku yake ciki: na ƙungiyarku, ko na Microsoft na kansa don asusun kai), lokacin da kuka haɗa shi da lokacin da kuka shiga da shi na ƙarshe, da ko asusunku yana da kalmar sirri ta kansa. Babu wani abu dabam daga mai bayarwa da ake ajiyewa: ba sunanku, hotonku ko wani maɓalli na asusunku a can ba. Yayin da kuke shiga, sabar tana ajiye bayanin shigar, tare da imel ɗin da mai bayarwa ya ce naku ne idan ana buƙata: don sabon asusu, inda ya zama imel ɗin asusunku (ba a amince da imel daga Microsoft haka kawai ba: kuna tabbatar da shi da mahaɗin da muka aika muku ta imel, kamar lokacin rajista), ko, idan asusun Glazecalc ya riga yana da wannan imel, don haɗa Google ko GitHub da shi da zarar kun shiga wannan asusu (ana haɗa Microsoft ne kawai daga shafin asusu). Ana share bayanin, da imel ɗin da ke ciki, cikin kusan minti 10.
privacy.providers: Shiga da Google, GitHub ko Microsoft zaɓinku ne, kuma yana faruwa ne kawai idan kun danna maɓallinsa. Burauzarku tana zuwa wannan mai bayarwa, wanda ke aika wa Glazecalc id ɗinsa a gare ku da imel ɗinku. Kowanne kamfani ne dabam, mai alhaki kan abin da kuka raba da shi ƙarƙashin manufofin sirrinsa. Babu rubutun kwamfuta ko hoto daga kowannensu da ke lodawa a shafukan Glazecalc.
privacy.keptProviders: Google, GitHub ko Microsoft: kowane haɗi har sai kun cire haɗin ko kun share asusunku. Shigar da ke gudana ana share ta bayan minti 10.

terms.title: Sharuɗɗan amfani
terms.short: Glazecalc kyauta ne don amfani. Yi amfani da shi don glaze ɗinku, bayananku da koyo, ku yi adalci ga sabar da kowa ke amfani da ita, kuma kada ku yi ƙoƙarin lalata shi.
terms.who: Glazecalc aiki ne na kyauta, buɗaɗɗen tushe, ba don riba ba, wanda mai shi, Aaron Filson, ke gudanarwa a Amurka. Waɗannan sharuɗɗa na amfani da shafin a glazecalcapp.com ne. Ta amfani da shi, kun yarda da su; idan ba ku yarda ba, don Allah kada ku yi amfani da shi.
terms.code: <source>Lambar tushen</source> Glazecalc kyauta ce ƙarƙashin MIT License, wadda ke bar kowa ya yi amfani da ita, ya kwafe ta, ya canza ta ya raba ta, ya kuma gudanar da nasa kwafi. Wannan lasisi na lambar ne. Waɗannan sharuɗɗa na wannan shafi ne: sabarsa, da asusun da kuka buɗe a kansa.
terms.useOwn: Yi amfani da shi don lissafa glaze, ajiye bayananku da koyo, a matsayin sha'awa, don koyarwa ko a kasuwanci.
terms.useAccount: Mutum ɗaya kan asusu ɗaya, da adireshin imel na kanku. Riƙe kalmar sirrinku, hanyoyin shigarku da access token ɗinku a wurinku: ku ne ke da alhakin abin da aka yi da su.
terms.useApps: Haɗa manhajar AI ko wata manhaja da asusunku zaɓinku ne. Manhajar da kuka yarda da ita tana aiki a madadinku: ku ne ke da alhakin abin da take yi a asusunku, kamar access token ɗinku. Kuna iya kawo ƙarshen damarta a kowane lokaci a shafin asusunku.
terms.useContent: Ajiye ku raba abin da kuke da haƙƙinsa kawai. Girke-girken da kuka raba ta mahaɗi duk wanda ke da mahaɗin zai iya karanta shi.
terms.useLaw: Yi amfani da Glazecalc bisa doka.
terms.yours: Abin da kuke ajiyewa ya kasance naku. Kuna bar Glazecalc ya ajiye shi, ya nuna shi ga mutanen da kuka raba shi da su, don gudanar da shafin kawai.
terms.leave: Kuna iya daina amfani da Glazecalc a kowane lokaci. Share asusuna, a shafin asusunku, yana cire asusunku da duk abin da ke ciki.
terms.fairIntro: Glazecalc yana gudana a kan ƙaramar sabar guda da kowa ke amfani da ita. Ta amfani da shi, kun yarda ba za ku:
terms.fairAttack: yi ƙoƙarin shiga sabar, shafin ko asusun wasu mutane, ko ku kashe shi ba. Idan kun sami matsalar tsaro, don Allah ku ba da rahotonta kamar yadda <security>manufar tsaro</security> ta nema, kuma kada ku gwada ta a kan bayanan wasu mutane.
terms.fairLoad: aika masa buƙatu fiye da yadda zai iya ɗauka ba, ko ku kauce wa iyakoki kan yawan sau da za a iya yin abubuwa. Waɗannan iyakoki suna sa shafin ya ci gaba da aiki ga kowa, kuma za su iya canzawa.
terms.fairScrape: kwafe shafin gaba ɗaya da crawler ko rubutun kwamfuta ba. Duk abin da aka gina shi da shi, lambarsa da bayanansa, yana kan <source>GitHub</source> tuni.
terms.fairAccounts: buɗe ƙarin asusu ko gwaje-gwaje don kauce wa iyaka ba, ko ku yi amfani da asusun wani.
terms.fairMail: yi amfani da rajista, sake saita kalmar sirri ko mahaɗan rabawa don aika wa mutane imel ko mahaɗan da ba su nema ba.
terms.fairHarm: ajiye ko raba wani abu da ba bisa doka ba ko mai cutarwa, ko wani abu da ba naku ba ne ku raba.
terms.fairScripts: Ana maraba da rubutun kwamfuta da mataimakan AI cikin waɗannan sharuɗɗa. Ba su access token na kanku, don abin da suke yi ya ƙidaya a matsayin naku.
terms.stop: Don shafin ya ci gaba da aiki, Glazecalc zai iya rage gudu ko ƙin buƙatu, dakatar da mahaɗin rabawa, ko rufe asusun da ya karya waɗannan sharuɗɗa ko ya jefa shafin cikin haɗari. Rufe asusu yana share shi. Inda ya dace, mai shi zai aika muku imel da farko ya ba ku lokaci don sauke bayananku.
terms.available: Glazecalc kyauta ne kuma yana gudana da ƙaramin kasafi. Zai iya tsayawa a wasu lokuta, don gyara ko bisa haɗari, fasalolinsa za su iya canzawa, kuma wata rana shafin zai iya rufewa. Idan haka ta faru, mai shi yana shirin aika wa masu asusu imel da farko ya bar musu lokaci don sauke bayanansu. Ana ba da taimako lokacin da mai shi ya samu dama, ba bisa jadawali ba. Ajiye kwafin duk abu mai muhimmanci: Sauke bayanaina, a shafin asusunku, yana ba ku duk abin da kuka ajiye.
terms.warranty: Ana bayar da Glazecalc yadda yake, ba tare da garanti na kowane iri ba. Gwargwadon yadda doka ta yarda, masu kula da shi ba su da alhaki kan wata asara ko lalacewa da ta samo asali daga amfani da shafin ko dogaro da shi. Babu abin da ke cikin waɗannan sharuɗɗa da ke ɗauke haƙƙoƙin da kuke da su bisa doka a inda kuke zaune.
terms.privacy: <privacy>Sanarwar sirri</privacy> tana faɗin abin da Glazecalc ke ajiyewa game da ku, dalili, da har yaushe.
terms.changes: Idan waɗannan sharuɗɗa suka canza, kwanan wata a saman shafin shi ma yana canzawa. Kan canjin da ya shafi masu asusu, mai shi zai yi ƙoƙarin aika musu imel kafin ya fara aiki.
terms.contact: Tambayoyi game da waɗannan sharuɗɗa: <hello>hello@glazecalcapp.com</hello>. Don ba da rahoton cin zarafin shafin: <abuse>abuse@glazecalcapp.com</abuse>. Don matsalolin tsaro, duba <security>manufar tsaro</security>.

notFound.heading: Ba a samu shafin ba
notFound.text: Babu shafi a wannan adireshi. Wataƙila an motsa shi, ko an rubuta mahaɗin ba daidai ba.

advice.title: Shawarwari kan glaze
advice.lead: Shawarwari masu amfani kan haɗawa, shafa glaze da gasa, da naku shawarwarin.
advice.signUp: <signup>Buɗe asusu kyauta</signup> ko <signin>shiga</signin> don ajiye naku shawarwarin.
advice.nothingSaved: Ba a ajiye komai ba tukuna.
advice.fetchFailed: An sami kuskure wajen samo bayanan shawarwari.
advice.saved: An yi nasarar ƙarawa cikin bayanan shawarwari.
advice.saveFailed: An sami kuskure wajen aika bayanan shawarar.

assistants.title: Yi amfani da Glazecalc daga mataimakin AI ɗinku
assistants.lead: Mataimakan AI kamar Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor da Gemini za su iya amfani da lissafin Glazecalc kai tsaye, ta Model Context Protocol (MCP).
assistants.what: Ba tare da asusu ba, mataimaki zai iya duba kaya a laburare, lissafa UMF na girke-girke, duba shi da iyakokin gasarsa, ba da shawarar maye gurbin kayan da aka daina yi, sake yin girke-girke daga kayan da kuka ambata, juya tsakanin cone da zafi, da nema da karanta jagororin. Babu abin da ya aika da ake ajiyewa; kamar kowane shafi, log na sabar yanar gizo yana rubuta adireshin IP, lokaci da adireshin kowace buƙata (ba a taɓa rubuta abin da aka aika ba), na kwana 14.
assistants.solve: Zai kuma iya yin girke-girke don UMF ko sinadaran oxide da kuka ba shi, daga kayan da kuka ambata, ya faɗi yadda ya kusanci, oxide bayan oxide. Idan asusunku yana haɗe, zai iya amfani da kayan da kuke da su.
assistants.mine: Da access token daga <account>shafin asusunku</account>, zai kuma iya karanta girke-girkenku, kayanku, littafin aikinku, bayanan gasa da kayan da kuke da su. Token da aka yi don karantawa kawai ba ya taɓa canza ko cire komai.
assistants.caution: Duba iyakoki gargaɗi ne daga iyakokin da aka wallafa, iri ɗaya da na cikin manhajar, ba tabbaci ba ne cewa glaze yana lafiya ga abinci. Gwada gasa kowane glaze, kuma ku sa a gwada glaze na wuraren da abinci ke taɓawa don zubar ƙarfe (leaching).
assistants.write: Token da aka yi don "Karantawa da canzawa" yana kuma bar mataimakinku ya ajiye girke-girken da ya lissafa tare da ku, tare da Glazecalc yana lissafa UMF ɗinsa, ya canza ɗaya daga cikin girke-girkenku ko kayanku, ya ƙara cikin littafin aikinku, ya yi wa kaya alama cewa kuna da su, ya kuma mayar da bayani zuwa Kwandon shara. Ba ya taɓa share komai har abada: duk abin da ya mayar zuwa Kwandon shara ana iya dawo da shi cikin kwana 30, kuma kowane canji yana ajiye bayanin kamar yadda yake, don ku iya soke shi a shafin yanar gizo. Ana ajiye muku abin da kowane token ya yi, a shafin Manhajojin da aka haɗa da cikin Sauke bayanaina.
assistants.writeSafely: Yi token da zai iya canza bayananku ne kawai don mataimaki ko rubutun kwamfuta da kuka amince da shi, kuma ku nemi ya faɗi abin da zai canza kafin ya yi. Ba shi mafi gajeren lokacin da zai isa (irin wannan token yana ɗaukar kwana 90 bai wuce haka ba), riƙe token na karantawa kawai don komai dabam, kuma ku soke shi da zarar an gama aikin. Sauke bayananku daga shafin asusunku da farko idan kuna son kwafi kamar yadda yake.
assistants.connectIntro: Akwai hanyoyi biyu na bar mataimaki ya kai ga bayananku. Duka suna farawa da karantawa kawai.
assistants.connectSignIn: Shiga daga manhajar. Claude, ChatGPT da wasu manhajoji da yawa suna haɗawa ta aika ku zuwa Glazecalc. Ku shiga, kuma Glazecalc yana nuna muku wace manhaja ke nema, adireshinta da inda amsarku za ta tafi, tare da gargaɗi idan amsar za ta tafi zuwa kwamfutarku. Manhajar za ta iya karanta bayananku; za ta iya canza su ne kawai idan kun kuma yi alama a "Kuma bar ta ta canza bayanaina". Sannan ku zaɓi Yarda ko Kada a yarda.
assistants.connectToken: Access token. Don mataimaki ko rubutun kwamfuta da ke aika header (Claude Code, VS Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI), yi token a shafin asusunku ku saka shi a cikin saitin da ke ƙasa.
assistants.connectSee: Kowace manhaja da token da kuka haɗa ana jera su a <apps>Manhajojin da aka haɗa</apps>, tare da abin da suka yi, kuma kuna iya soke kowannensu a can a kowane lokaci. Kowace sabuwar manhajar da kuka haɗa tana kuma aika muku imel.
assistants.address: Ba mataimakinku wannan adireshi, ta amfani da hanyar Streamable HTTP:
assistants.token: Don bar shi ya karanta bayananku, yi token a <account>shafin asusunku</account> ku kwafe shi. Mataimakinku yana aika shi a cikin header na Authorization, a matsayin Bearer sannan token ɗin. Kada ku saka shi a fayilolin da kuke rabawa ko kuke commit, kamar yadda za ku yi da kalmar sirri.
assistants.claudeCodeToken: Da access token, don karanta bayananku su ma:
assistants.vscode: A cikin .vscode/mcp.json a cikin folda, ko saitunanku na mai amfani. VS Code yana neman token ɗin sau ɗaya kuma yana ɓoye shi; cire headers da inputs don amfani da kayan aikin da ba sa buƙatar asusu kawai:
assistants.cursor: A cikin ~/.cursor/mcp.json, ko .cursor/mcp.json a cikin project. Cire headers don amfani da kayan aikin da ba sa buƙatar asusu kawai:
assistants.gemini: A cikin ~/.gemini/settings.json. Cire headers don amfani da kayan aikin da ba sa buƙatar asusu kawai:
assistants.copyForToken: Kwafe saitin don {client}, tare da access token
assistants.copyByHand: Ba a iya kwafe muku shi ba. An zaɓe shi: kwafe shi daga akwatin.
assistants.apps: Ƙara custom connector da adireshin da ke sama. Idan manhajar ta tambaya, ku shiga Glazecalc ku zaɓi abin da za ta iya yi, kamar yadda aka bayyana a sama.
assistants.dictation: Saka skill ɗin rubuce-rubucen aiki na Glazecalc a cikin manhajar AI ɗinku, sannan ku yi magana ko ku rubuta yayin da kuke aiki. Yana mayar da abin da kuka faɗa zuwa girke-girke, bayanan gasa, sakamakon test tile da rubuce-rubuce, yana karanta muku kowanne, kuma yana ajiye shi a asusunku ne kawai idan kun ce eh. Muryar ta manhajarku ce: Glazecalc ba ya taɓa jin ta.
assistants.dictationNeeds: Yana buƙatar Glazecalc a haɗe da alama a "Kuma bar ta ta canza bayanaina", ko token da zai iya "Karantawa da canzawa". Idan kun zaɓi a Manhajojin da aka haɗa ku amince da canje-canje, kowane ajiyewa yana jiran amincewarku a can shi ma.
assistants.dictationClaude: Claude (yanar gizo da kwamfuta): kunna code execution a saituna, sannan a Customize, Skills, zaɓi +, Create skill, Upload a skill, ku zaɓi ZIP ɗin. Ƙara Glazecalc a matsayin connector shi ma.
assistants.dictationClaudeCode: Claude Code: buɗe ZIP ɗin cikin ~/.claude/skills/, ku ƙara Glazecalc kamar yadda aka nuna a sama.
assistants.dictationChatGpt: ChatGPT, inda tsarinku yake ba da skills: ɗora ZIP ɗin a matsayin skill, ku ƙara Glazecalc a matsayin app.
assistants.dictationPrompt: A sauran mataimaka, zaɓi prompt ɗin Glazecalc "Dictate studio notes": yana ɗauke da umarni iri ɗaya.
assistants.stop: Soke token a <account>shafin asusunku</account> a kowane lokaci. Kowane token yana daina aiki a ranar da kuka zaɓa, kuma dukkansu suna tsayawa nan take idan kun sake saita kalmar sirrinku ko kun fita a ko'ina.
assistants.limits: Kowane adireshi zai iya yin buƙatu 60 a minti da 2,000 a rana; asusun da ke amfani da token, 300 a minti da 20,000 a rana. An iyakance maye gurbi da daidaitawa zuwa 10 a minti. An iyakance canje-canjen da aka yi da token zuwa 60 a minti da 5,000 a rana kan kowane asusu, kuma kowane token zai iya mayar da bayanai 100 a awa zuwa Kwandon shara.
